instructions.original_snippets: NEVER use any as a default escape hatch
instructions.content: Never use any as a shortcut past a type error; it disables checking entirely and hides the design bug the error was pointing at.

instructions.original_snippets: Every generic parameter should carry a meaningful constraint
instructions.content: Give every generic type parameter a meaningful constraint (extends object, extends Record<string, unknown>, etc.) rather than leaving it unconstrained.

instructions.original_snippets: NEVER hand-write a type that duplicates what infer or a mapped type could derive
instructions.content: Never hand-write a type that duplicates what ReturnType, Parameters, or an infer-based conditional type could derive directly from the source; a hand-written copy drifts out of sync.

instructions.original_snippets: Use infer within conditional types to extract nested type information
instructions.content: Use the infer keyword inside a conditional type's extends clause to extract a type from a function, array, promise, or other generic structure instead of writing a separate extraction by hand.

instructions.original_snippets: Template literal types can parse structure out of a string literal at the type level
instructions.content: Use a template literal type to parse structure (like route parameters) out of a string literal type, so a typo in the literal is a compile error rather than a runtime miss.
